scope: Current local production UI illustrations; not a full-suite, device, participant, deployment or codec qualification

sourceInputGuard.scope: Tracked and new non-ignored non-Markdown inputs, excluding docs/

themeGallery.artwork: The same original 56x32 three-frame sample, imported through the project dialog

procedure: Isolated disposable browser contexts and actual current UI controls. Built-in sample artwork was assembled as a project fixture and imported normally. Lesson poses were cleared and traced through the UI. Recovery/archive examples use deliberately damaged local fixtures; no real artist browser data was touched. No diagnostic reporting or Co-Draw session was enabled.
compression: PNG containers were losslessly recompressed. Every published image was independently decoded and its complete RGBA hash matched its retained native capture.
review: Contact-sheet and selected full-size review recorded in the audit follow-up; screenshots illustrate available states, not user learning or global accessibility.
limits: Raw logs, original captures, failed stale capture selectors and workflow setup attempts remain local. Successful isolated archive and game-delivery workflow assertions have their own retained logs. Historical verdicts keep their original labels.
